newsitem.title: USA: Charter Power to upgrade Arizona plant.
newsitem.headline: Charter Power to upgrade Arizona plant.

text.p: Charter Power Systems Inc said Wednesday it will spend $5 million to upgrade and automate its electronics facility in Tucson, Ariz.
Charter also said it has consolidated its various electronics operations into a single unit called the Power Electronics Division, with headquaters in Tucson.

Charter, which makes electrical power storage and conversion products, said the investment for a surface mount device assembly equipment will give it state-of-the-art technology to manufacture a wide range of AC/DC power supplies, converters, telecomunications rectifiers and battery charger products.
